countUnits.face: 100m of one eligible block face, not both sides of every block
countUnits.people: expected instantaneous people present, not arrivals/hour; fractional expectations are stochastic means
countUnits.assets: expected active/visible instances; vehicles are snapshot presence not hourly vehicle flow
countUnits.linearFeatures: 100m qualified path/river edge for lake/runners/boat examples; platform/dock/garage counts are site-bound and do not length-scale
countUnits.hours: local 06:00,12:00,18:00,23:00; interpolate within schedule, not UTC

anchor.approvedFileIdentity: UNRESOLVED: no unambiguous approval/file mapping found; clarification requested
anchor.instructionPriority: User's explicit blue-sky mid-afternoon description and Denver balance take precedence over contradictory file numbering

sky.interpolation: Linear RGB; elevation above world horizon, not screen height
sky.cloudPolicy: One clear partly cloudy preset; projected clouds differ with camera direction, not per-view color grades

sun.fixturePolicy: One illustrative art-review fixture in world coordinates. No timestamp/location or camera headings have been validated from images. Production live/recap solar model overrides fixture elevation/azimuth; never falsify real weather/time to enforce hero lighting.
sun.fillCalibration: On the same neutral diagnostic plane, normalized lit contributions are direct=.38 and diffuse fill=.62, giving shadow/lit=.62 before AO. These are contribution ratios, not renderer-specific environment intensity units. Calibrate against E0; directIntensityRelativeClearE0=1 retains the clear-state sun scale.

shadows.tintRole: Cool-neutral gray-blue appearance cue, not a purple overlay on every surface or a replacement albedo
shadows.softEdgePolicy: Existing filtered directional shadows with moderate penumbra; preserve dark geometric recesses. No additional shadow map/light/pass.
shadows.occlusionMerge: min(existingVisibility,newVisibility); don't multiply repeated contact AO

exposure.reference: Frozen clear-day E0 from existing paintover-v1 ordinary-street, not absolute camera EV/lux
exposure.toneMapPolicy: Use one renderer tone mapper/white balance across views. Warm sun is lighting; no extra yellow/sepia post-grade.

ground.colorRole: Dry neutral reference/base swatches, not fixed lit/shadow pixels

trees.positionPolicy: Keep existing trunk bases and approximate crown envelopes

dressing.placement: Illustrative inferred curbside dressing; road-side of curb only, clear sidewalks and drive accesses
dressing.lamps: A few generic unlit posts in parkway; no extra daytime lights
dressing.treePits: Small earth/mulch pits at existing parkway trunks only; not authorization to move trees or pave lawns

compatibility.conflict: Per-frame grades vary: ordinary +.35 EV vs Lakeview +.20 EV and golden palettes. New shared hero block supersedes those per-frame day grades for these four references only.
compatibility.resolution: Use ordinary +.35 EV/1.06 contrast/1.08 saturation once; remove old warmth grade (4%) because warm light tint now supplies warmth. Preserve houseTypes values.

compatibility.conflict: Ordinary 15:30 uses +.10 EV and #99AFE0 fill. Hero uses +.35 EV referenced to paintover-v1 E0 and neutralized #AEBCCA fill; no renderer equivalence proven. The old 2.2 key:fill witness ratio also conflicts with a .62 shadow/lit witness ratio if both mean contributions on the same plane.
compatibility.resolution: This is an explicitly versioned hero review preset, not a silent rewrite of time-of-day keys. Calibrate E0 and witness patch before adopting in engine. For the shared hero witness use direct .38 / fill .62, hence key:fill .612903. Do not also apply the legacy 2.2 contribution ratio.

compatibility.conflict: Hero dry ground/wetness=0 is inapplicable to rain. Rain's per-surface darkening and roughness changes must not be stacked with another wetness policy.
compatibility.resolution: Keep dry palette as base. When rain active, rain-v1 materialFormula overrides dry roughness; apply its single darkening multiplier (max12%) once, then weather-state light/sky override hero clear sun.

compatibility.conflict: Hero directSun=1/blue sky/+.35 EV cannot coexist with blue-hour directSun=0/+ .20EV, night directSun=0/+ .35EV or morning-fog reduced direct sun/optical depth.
compatibility.resolution: Hero is one clear daytime state only. At night/blue-hour/fog use named state lighting, exposure and atmosphere as replacements, not summed EV or hero sun beneath fog/night. House geometry/base palette remains shared.

compatibility.conflict: Earlier validation said source lighting direction remained close. This revision intentionally changes lighting, ground color balance and postcard vegetation/dressing.
compatibility.resolution: Supersede earlier validation for new hero files; originals remain intact. Generated shadow bearings and exact hex pixels are illustrative, not measured.

people.faceDetail: soft anonymous; no identity detail at any tier

vehicles.transportAnchor: Japan regional kit vehicles/rail/stations per Style B Bible; adapt to US dimensions

countRule: For each eligible mapped site: baseline expected count x season x active game-day people multiplier. Event-only assets instead use event table while its explicit event gate is active; do not add baseline again. Mapped static assets use supplied count, never stochastic spawn. Seed persistent site IDs; clamp to space and shared city budget.

gameDay.requires: validated venue/event start/end; never a fixed 6pm game or inference from jersey colours
gameDay.avoidDoubleCounting: event people replace site baseline before applying multiplier; shared pedestrian pool handles people across food/bar/queue/crowd roles

placement.poleRule: Mapped only in engine. Alley pole art is illustration, not observed location.
placement.accessibility: preserve actual mapped curb ramps, doors, crossings and emergency access; 1.8m is authored minimum target, not claimed local code
placement.transit: existing route/track/service and platform masks; no L in every Lakeview street and no light rail on Sloan lake path
placement.snow: history-based piles after clearing, no piles across ramps; spring leaf-out independent
placement.hydrant: explicit event/demo only; heat does not automatically open hydrants
placement.chairs: cultural reference/demo only; does not assert official legal reservation or endorse availability

boards: 01-chicago-food
Chicago · neighbourhood food
Hot dog walk-up stand, plain small awning and one vendor serving two people.
Italian beef counter visible through a plain walk-up window, no menu lettering.
Corner tavern with plain awning, sidewalk tables, people in neutral clothing.
Pizza counter with blank fascia, seated customers.
Paleta pushcart with small shade umbrella and frozen treats.
Tamale vendor beside a compact insulated cooler and plain folding table.
Ice cream truck parked legally with blank panels and walk-up window.
Chicago Lakeview corner context, brick two-flats and modest shops, no giant skyline.
Close real-scale generic food containers and hands without faces in detail.
02-chicago-alleys
Chicago · alley life
Blue and black wheeled refuse carts behind rear garages, normal human scale.
Unbranded full-size rear-loading garbage truck collecting in an alley, workers generic no insignia.
Rear garage entrances behind brick two-flats, alley utility poles and overhead cables.
Same rear lane with blue and black bins at garage edges, clear truck travel path; no invented poles on front streets.
03-chicago-transit
Chicago · transit
Elevated L station platform waiting crowd and visible steel stairs, blank signs.
Real-proportioned silver generic L train passing on elevated structure above Lakeview street.
Full-size generic city bus, neutral plain livery without badges or agency symbols, passengers waiting at curb.
Generic small passenger water taxi on Chicago River beside downtown riverwalk, real-scale boat and passengers, no text.
04-chicago-game-day
Chicago · ballpark day
Pedestrian crowds walking toward unmarked Lakeview brick ballpark exterior, clothes neutral mixed colours, no jersey marks.
Rooftop bleacher structures visible from neighbourhood street outside ballpark, structural realism.
Corner bars and tavern patios spilling onto sidewalk inside designated space, clear walking corridor, no marks/signs.
05-chicago-seasons
Chicago · seasonal life
Summer street festival tents on explicitly closed street, small crowds.
Opened fire hydrant cooling a hot-day street, restrained water spray and generic residents, no animals.
Lakefront shared path runners and cyclists in separate plausible directions.
Beach volleyball game near Lake Michigan, real adult proportions, no text on shirts.
Harbour sailboats at moorings, plausible real-scale masts.
Winter lawn chairs saving a shoveled curbside parking space, snowbanks; chairs are props not official reserved signs.
Generic salt spreader truck travelling snowy roadway.
Plowed snow piles at corners away from clear crossings and curb ramps.
Unbranded full-size snowplow with blade after snowfall, no insignia.
06-chicago-porches
Chicago · porch evenings
Chicago brick two-flat evening stoop life, seated and standing adult neighbours, soft anonymous faces, warm sparse window light and cool readable fill.
Chicago bungalow porch evening, real-scale adults chatting, small porch chairs, coherent cool dusk and restrained local warm light.
07-denver-food
Denver · neighbourhood food
Generic food trucks beside Sloan's Lake neighbourhood main street, real adult customers and blank panels.
Unbranded brewery patio with plain canopy, real-scale picnic tables and neutral dressed adults, no words or logos.
Farmers market tents in a designated neighbourhood market site near Sloan's Lake, produce crates and adult shoppers.
08-denver-mobility
Denver · getting around
Denver-area light rail on actual dedicated track corridor, unbranded generic train with overhead catenary, not on Sloan lake path.
Bike commuters on Denver neighbourhood bike lane, real-proportioned people and bicycles.
Generic scooters ridden in permitted street/bike lane, no company colours or logos, not on lake path.
Parked generic full-size cars with plausible roof ski racks and rear bike racks outside Denver houses, blank badges; no Chicago skyline.
09-denver-moments
Denver · stadium, snow & lake
Game-day crowd approaching unmarked Empower Field horseshoe stadium with undulating silver rim and brick supports, no horse sculpture, logos, team insignia or branded colours.
Generic Denver snowplow after spring snowfall, partly green trees retain leaves under snow caps, clear crossings, west Front Range backdrop with NO downtown behind mountains.
Sloan's Lake path runners, modest urban lake, Denver residential edges, mountain view west, no Chicago skyline or giant Great Lake horizon.
